spoiler.hiddenItem: The name, location and hint are hidden to avoid spoilers.
spoiler.hiddenName: The name and location are hidden to avoid spoilers. The hint below is safe.

status.left-behind: Left behind: its deadline has passed

transfer.title: Move your progress
transfer.intro: Progress lives only on this device. Export one file with all your games to back it up or open it on another phone.
transfer.confirm: Replace the progress on this device with the games in the file?

error.wrong-format: That file isn't an exported progress file.
error.newer-version: That file comes from a newer version of the app. Reload and try again.

credits.title: Credits
credits.sourcesIntro: Facts were checked against these guides and rewritten in our own words. Thank you to their authors.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.progress: Your progress is stored only in this browser. We never receive it.
privacy.analytics: Analytics are cookieless and aggregate (page views and a few anonymous events). No item ids and no personal data.
privacy.suggestions: When suggestions are enabled, we will keep only the text you send, an optional nickname and a one-way hash of your IP address to limit spam.

boss.sectionHint: Names and strategies stay hidden until you reveal them. Not counted in progress.

collections.title: Collections
collections.fishHint: Tick a fish once it is in your fishing log. Fish from later chapters appear as you advance.
collections.recipesHint: Tick a dish once it is in your recipe book. Dishes from later chapters appear as you advance.
collections.noFish: No fishing yet in the chapters you have reached.
collections.noRecipes: No recipes yet in the chapters you have reached.
